views.markdown:
A fork of AnthoPak's open-source PanCake.

Swipe back from anywhere on the screen in any app, and bring back the page just left.

* go back with a swipe anywhere on the page.
* restore the previous page with a swipe in from the right edge.
* haptic feedback on the back gesture, in five strengths.
* disable in selected apps.
* link the fork's source code in the credits.

* show the package icon after install.
* add a Tip on Ko-fi row to the credits.
* reword the credit line in the description.

* move to the com.cysxl package id, replacing AnthoPak's PanCake.

Changes from AnthoPak's open-source PanCake 1.1:
* support roothide and rootless.
* add Restore Previous Page, and Back Gesture on Whole Page to switch the whole-page swipe.
* add Play in Disabled Apps for haptic feedback.
* stop loading into SpringBoard.
* apply switches without relaunching the app.
* stop the haptic firing when the back gesture is off.
* check the blacklist on an app's first launch too.
* read settings without Cephei.
